name: housing_analyst
paragraphs: The Copenhagen rental market remains constrained. Applicants should expect documentation of income and little room for negotiation.
Landlords, for their part, cite the cost of compliance with fire regulations. These explanations are not always false; they are, however, routinely overused.
A deposit equivalent to three months' rent is now typical in the inner districts, even for rooms that would not survive a municipal inspection.
Consequently, short-term legal lets are scarce, and informal sublets absorb the overflow.
